name: ostoyae
description: A graph runner for coding agents, where the graph grows from what the agents find. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: node rehearsals/providers.mjs && node rehearsals/process-identity.mjs && node rehearsals/messaging.mjs && node rehearsals/overlap.mjs && node rehearsals/multiple-boards.mjs && node rehearsals/campaign-ownership.mjs && node rehearsals/ingest.mjs && node rehearsals/dag.mjs && for t in cli land check install onboarding readiness allowance campaign budget claude-usage codex correction crash identity doctor executors gate judge launch-budgets question summary duplicate-park hygiene tools viewer stop; do bash bin/rehearse-$t || exit 1; done && bin/ostoyae demo --no-viewer
